regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing rotation (eligible breadth 7/16) with Big Banks as the headline theme (eligible, trend, full breadth, durability 0.8) and Oil & Gas as the raw momentum leader but ineligible (durability 0.19, mixed). The only validated edge on this market is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control (gate_helps: true); cross-sectional rank and rotation timing carry no forward edge. A direction-accuracy track record of 0.313 against a deliberate 'discipline_not_prediction' contract calls for humility.
emerging_watch: Watching Oil & Gas Producers (ca_oil_gas) and Pipelines & Midstream: both are currently ineligible on weak durability (0.19 and 0.28) despite Oil & Gas holding the raw leader rank. I am watching for ca_oil_gas durability_bar to recover above the eligibility threshold alongside a trend Hurst tag — if that condition is met, the watch retires and the theme re-enters as a genuine stayer; if durability stays below threshold through a further 10 trading days, the watch is dropped.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the only theme combining the detector's trend-gate eligibility with full breadth (1.0), a strong durability bar (0.8), and a trend Hurst tag — all coincident staying-power legs, not return forecasts. It is the rotational challenger to Oil & Gas with rising durability. This is a size-up-on-confirmed-strength stance, not an alpha claim.
theses.dissent: The rotation is narrowing and absorption is low (0.32); Bank of Canada/policy surprise share is extreme (unscheduled_share 1.0), and Canadian banks are heavily macro- and credit-sensitive — a single unscheduled macro shock could break the trend cohort regardless of breadth.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO closes below its 50-day moving average while the absolute-trend gate flips ca_banks to ineligible

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: The only eligible theme carrying a crowding flag (crowded: true, crowding_z 1.03) while durability is high (0.79) and trend is intact. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade — expressed here as avoiding fresh adds to a theme where flow may already mark a local top.
theses.dissent: Staples & Retail has full breadth and a high durability bar — defensive flow under elevated macro uncertainty could keep this theme leading for longer than a crowding flag would suggest.

falsifier.text: XST.TO makes a new 20-day high while crowding_z falls below 0.5

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is eligible but crowded (crowding_z 1.25, the highest in the eligible set) with a mixed Hurst tag and a negative momentum score. This is a size-down/cap read, not a short — the trend gate has not disqualified it, but the crowding texture argues against adding exposure.
theses.dissent: AI-tech is the dominant macro narrative in Canada's flow headlines (8 of 21 recent mentions), and Technology retains broad participation (breadth 0.7); narrative attention could sustain leadership even as crowding is coincident-only.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX by 5% over the next 20 trading days while crowding_z remains positive
